milestones.title: Campaign Governance & Verified Baseline
milestones.goal: Create the honest baseline and scoped execution contract; prevent this recovery program itself becoming another unbounded prompt campaign.

milestones.title: Canonical Acceptance Contract & Trust Boundaries
milestones.goal: Make one typed, canonical, versioned acceptance contract that cannot be silently rewritten by the worker being judged.

milestones.title: Pinned Verification & Evidence Provenance
milestones.goal: Replace worker-chosen vacuous verification with reviewer-controlled proof and replayable evidence.

milestones.title: Independent CI / Forge Merge Gate
milestones.goal: Move acceptance to a verifier the worker cannot trivially bypass; keep canonical policy platform-neutral.

milestones.title: Effect-Proof Doctrine & Enforcement Audit
milestones.goal: Replace grep-existence proofs with behavioural enforcement probes, including inverse/orphan-wiring checks.

milestones.title: Policy Parser, Scope Diff & Safety Correctness
milestones.goal: Fix correctness/security holes audit identified, not merely their examples.

milestones.title: Native Vendor Hook Projection
milestones.goal: Compile one contract to vendor-native preventive hooks, with documented capability differences and independent CI fallback.

milestones.title: Minimal Adoption Profile & Fast First Run
milestones.goal: Make the essential acceptance workflow usable without the rest of the platform.

milestones.title: Lifecycle Ownership & Surface Convergence
milestones.goal: Eliminate shell/Rust split-brain by choosing a single authoritative write model; keep projections truly derived.

milestones.title: MCP Context-Surface Compression
milestones.goal: Make MCP discovery proportional to tasks without destroying API usefulness.

milestones.title: Claims, Evidence Ratchet & Honest Documentation
milestones.goal: Make public verification claims backed by recorded proof rather than link-presence or baseline waivers.

milestones.title: Real Intent-to-Evidence Product Pilot
milestones.goal: Prove one real product outcome from intent to CI-verified acceptance rather than two self-referential intent records.

milestones.title: Five External Users & Product Validation
milestones.goal: Validate real adoption before resuming platform expansion; no fake cohorts.

milestones.title: Optional Subsystems Audit & Scope Budget
milestones.goal: Retain, isolate, or retire optional subsystems by measured costs and demonstrated use; no ideological bulk deletion.
